title: At the Café
text:
This is the menu at a small café. It has soup, salad, and bread. The soup is hot and good in winter. You can also order a cold drink.

For dessert, there is ice cream and cake. The cake costs five dollars. If you want more water, ask the waiter. He will bring it to your table.

questions.text: What does the menu have for the first course?
How much does the cake cost?
Why might someone order the hot soup?
options: They want something warm on a cold day
They want something cold to drink

questions.text: What should you do if you want more water?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
a sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
a person who brings food and drinks to your table
to ask for food or drinks in a restaurant

paragraph_translations: Bu küçük bir kafenin menüsü. Çorba, salata ve ekmek var. Çorba sıcak ve kışın çok güzel. Soğuk bir içecek de sipariş edebilirsiniz.
Tatlı olarak dondurma ve pasta var. Pasta beş dolar. Daha fazla su isterseniz garsona sorun. O, suyu masanıza getirecektir.
